stories.title: Ashok Leyland revenue rises 39 percent
stories.summary: Ashok Leyland reported Q2FY27 revenue of 13,364 crore rupees, up 39 percent year over year. Domestic commercial vehicle volumes reached a record 59,575 units. While the company maintains a net cash surplus of 3,546 crore rupees, auditors have flagged discrepancies in loan balances between underlying systems.

stories.title: Landmark Cars reports record EBITDA
stories.summary: Landmark Cars recorded its highest-ever EBITDA in Q2FY27, with new energy vehicles accounting for 29 percent of total sales. Per-service revenue reached a record 30,300 rupees, which the company says offset volume dips caused by Gujarat floods. Free cash flow is now directed toward debt repayment.

stories.title: Auto-cab drivers on one side, Vietnam EV giant on the other. Prize is Bengaluru’s private transport space - ThePrint
India electric vehicle share reaches 8.8 percent
stories.summary: Former NITI Aayog CEO Amitabh Kant stated that India's battery electric vehicle share reached 8.8 percent in September 2026, surpassing the United States at 6.8 percent. Kant noted that the next phase of growth for the country will depend on building a stronger charging infrastructure.

stories.title: Amitabh Kant flags India's BEV lead over US, calls for charging infrastructure push - ET Auto
PM E-DRIVE records over 30 lakh EV sales till September 2026: Kumaraswamy - ET Auto
Government stresses charging network for EV growth
stories.summary: Minister for Heavy Industries HD Kumaraswamy stated that more than 30 lakh electric vehicles have been sold under the PM E-DRIVE scheme as of September 30, 2026. The minister emphasized that sustaining this momentum requires rapid expansion of functional and accessible charging stations across urban and rural areas.

stories.title: Gujarat hosts first AI-powered critical mineral observatory
stories.summary: India launched its first AI-powered Critical Mineral Observatory in Ahmedabad during an international roundtable on resilient supply chains. The event was organized by the Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation and the Commissioner of Geology and Mining as a pre-summit engagement for the Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit 2027.

stories.title: Battery swapping models change ownership economics
stories.summary: The Indian battery swapping ecosystem aims to reduce upfront costs by separating battery ownership from vehicle ownership. Service providers take on responsibilities for maintenance, charging, and lifecycle management. The business model is intended to change the economics of electric vehicle ownership for customers in the country.

stories.title: BYD India reaches 20,000 delivery milestone
stories.summary: BYD has delivered 20,000 vehicles in India, with the last 10,000 units reaching customers in roughly 14 months. The company recently introduced its premium Denza brand to the market, adding the D9 and Z9 GT models to its existing portfolio of electric passenger vehicles.

stories.title: BYD Sells 20,000 Electric Cars In India
stories.summary: BYD has crossed 20,000 customer deliveries in India, a milestone that shows how far the Chinese electric-car maker has come in the premium EV market. The company marked the occasion by handing over its 20,000th vehicle at PPS BYD in Delhi on November 20, with senior executives attending the ceremony.

stories.title: BYD India Doubles EV Deliveries in Just 14 Months, Atto 3 & Sealion 7 Lead the Growth - Auto India Daily
stories.summary: BYD India has achieved an important milestone in its electric passenger vehicle business. The company’s cumulative customer deliveries crossed 20,000 units in November 2026. Interestingly, it took BYD nearly four years to complete the first 10,000 customer handovers, but the company achieved the next 10,000 deliveries in just 14 months.

stories.summary: The demand for electric cars in India is growing rapidly and BYD is also taking advantage of it. BYD has so far delivered more than 20 thousand electric cars in the country. The point is that it took a little over a year for the company to reach 10,000 to

stories.title: BYD India Hits 20,000 Sales Mark
stories.summary: Denza luxury brand launched in India - DM-I plugin hybrid tech next in pipeline BYD India has crossed the milestone of 20,000 customer deliveries in India. The number is significant as it had announced crossing the10,000 customer deliveries in September 2025, BYD India has doubled this milestone in just over

stories.title: BYD India Crosses 20,000 Customer Deliveries Milestone
stories.summary: BYD India has crossed the 20,000-customer delivery milestone, more than doubling its cumulative deliveries in just over a year. The company had announced 10,000 customer deliveries in September 2025, marking a steady expansion of its electric passenger vehicle business in the country. To mark the occasion, BYD India held a

stories.summary: BYD has crossed the 20,000-unit sales milestone in India. The carmaker reached 10,000 deliveries in September 2025, meaning it has doubled that figure in just over a year. BYD currently has 51 showrooms across 40 cities in the country and recently introduced its luxury brand Denza here with the launch

stories.title: Royal Enfield offers 10-year warranty in UK
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has introduced a Service Activated Warranty in the UK, covering bikes for up to 10 years or 70,000 miles. The scheme is free for riders who use authorised service centres. The company already provides a 3-year manufacturer warranty as standard for its motorcycles.

stories.title: Karnataka considers bike taxi regulations
stories.summary: Karnataka Transport Minister Byrathi Suresh said the state will consult the Advocate General before deciding on bike taxi services. Following a Supreme Court order, the government is considering framing specific regulations and restrictions for the sector rather than implementing a total ban on operations.

stories.title: Terra Motors launches Y4Alfa e-rickshaw, priced at Rs 1.3 lakh - ET Auto
Yamaha’s first ever Scooter Boutique launched in India at Chennai - ET Auto
Forest team attacked by sand mafia in Madhya Pradesh
stories.summary: A Forest Department team in Sheopur was attacked by a group using stones and sticks while attempting to seize a tractor-trolley for illegal sand transport. Two forest personnel were injured in the incident. Police have arrested two individuals involved in the confrontation.

stories.title: Sand mafia recovers seized tractor in Sheopur
stories.summary: Members of the sand mafia attacked a National Chambal Sanctuary team on Thursday to reclaim a confiscated tractor-trolley. The assailants crashed a government vehicle and threw stones at officials. One forest guard was hospitalised following the clash, which occurred during a patrol near the Chambal River.

stories.title: Auto union questions safety after fatal drunk driving crash
stories.summary: The EV Auto Drivers Union has questioned local traffic enforcement after a drunk driver killed an auto-rickshaw driver on the Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee flyover in Guwahati. A passenger remains in critical condition. The deceased was the sole breadwinner for his family.

stories.title: China EV market share hits 68 percent
stories.summary: Electric vehicles reached a 68 percent market share in China during October, a new record. The milestone follows a 27 percent year-over-year decline in the overall automotive market, driven by a significant drop in internal combustion engine sales. Records are easier to set when the competition stops showing up.

stories.title: Rising Demand Means It’s Hard to Find an EV in the US - Bloomberg.com
US dealer EV inventory drops as sales climb
stories.summary: US electric vehicle sales rose 11 percent in October 2026 compared to the previous year, while dealer inventory fell 38 percent. Dealers held approximately 65,000 electric vehicles in early November. Automakers have cut production following the expiration of federal purchase incentives.

stories.title: EV price gap with gas cars narrows
stories.summary: The average price of a new electric vehicle is now 9.4 percent higher than a combustion car, according to Kelley Blue Book data from August. This represents a decrease from the 16 percent price gap observed at the same time last year.

stories.title: US Car Dealerships Are Low on EV Models - Bloomberg.com
US EV registrations fall 41 percent in January
stories.summary: Electric vehicle registrations in the United States dropped 41 percent in January compared to the same period last year. EVs now hold a 5.1 percent market share, down from 8.3 percent in January 2025. Registrations have declined every month since federal tax credits were removed.

stories.title: North East Development Commission prepares for electric vehicle rollout
stories.summary: The North East Development Commission is training stakeholders in Maiduguri ahead of the distribution of 10,330 electric vehicles. The fleet will include 10,000 tricycles, 300 taxis, and 30 buses. The programme aims to address transport costs and hardship in the region.

stories.title: Kurdistan region sets 15 percent import duty on electric cars
stories.summary: The Kurdistan Regional Government will apply a 15 percent customs duty on imported electric cars starting January 1, 2027. The directive covers fully electric models and range-extender vehicles. Fully electric cars will remain exempt from license plate and environmental fees.

stories.title: China EV penetration projected to exceed 70 percent
stories.summary: Electric vehicles are expected to account for 70.6 percent of new car sales in China for November. The projected record comes as overall vehicle sales decline, with petrol car sales falling 46.9 percent year-on-year. Consumers are increasingly choosing electric options as the wider market shrinks.

stories.title: India electric truck sales rise 254 percent
stories.summary: Registrations of electric heavy and medium trucks in India increased 254 percent in 2026. Large companies are increasingly replacing diesel vehicles with electric alternatives for logistics operations. The growth has created new demand for commercial vehicle manufacturers and charging infrastructure providers.

stories.title: Ashok Leyland expects CV replacement cycle to gain pace amid GST-led freight revival - ET Auto
Ford Trucks advances battery passport readiness
stories.summary: Ford Trucks is advancing its electric mobility portfolio with the F-LINE E, a heavy commercial vehicle featuring 392 kWh of battery capacity and a 300 kilometre range. The company is currently working to align its battery data with emerging passport requirements for the heavy-duty transport sector.

stories.title: GM to wind down Silverado 1500 production in Oshawa by year end amid pivot to heavy-duty pickups - Automotive News
Tesla increases Shanghai output amid domestic sales decline
stories.summary: Tesla plans to ramp up production at its Shanghai Gigafactory despite domestic deliveries falling 66.1 percent to 8,817 vehicles in October. While local sales reached their lowest level since July 2022, exports from the facility surged 66.3 percent. The company remains confident in China's manufacturing capabilities.

stories.title: Montra Electric deploys tractors at Action TESA
stories.summary: Montra Electric has deployed seven E-45 electric tractors at an Action TESA manufacturing facility in Visakhapatnam. The initiative aims to introduce electric mobility to the medium density fibreboard sector, as the company evaluates electric tractors as a sustainable alternative to conventional industrial material-handling equipment.

stories.title: Highway accident on Kadi-Thol road
stories.summary: A runaway tractor struck a motorcyclist on the Kadi-Thol Highway on 20 November after being hit by a dumper. The incident, which lasted seven seconds, was recorded by a nearby CCTV camera. The injured rider was transported to a private hospital for treatment.

stories.title: O'Reilly Automotive bids $10 billion for Genuine Parts
stories.summary: O'Reilly Automotive has placed a $10 billion bid to acquire the automotive unit of Genuine Parts Company, which owns NAPA Auto Parts. Genuine Parts Company has expressed interest in separating its industrial operations from its auto parts business by early next year.

Sandhar Technologies signs exclusive joint venture with Daeshin Machinery of Korea - ET Auto
Japanese automakers to standardize vehicle parts
stories.summary: Toyota, Nissan, and Honda will standardize vehicle parts including steel quality, plastic protocols, and wiring harness color-coding to reduce production costs. Discussions are currently underway with domestic suppliers in Japan, with plans to include international partners in the near future.

stories.title: FAI Auto Parts appoints senior product manager
stories.summary: FAI Auto Parts has appointed Michael Keen as senior product manager to oversee its steering, suspension, wheel bearing, and driveline ranges. Keen will use customer feedback and market trends to identify new parts for the company's automotive aftermarket portfolio.

stories.title: Automotive coolant reservoir market shifts for 2026
stories.summary: The global automotive coolant reservoir tank market enters 2026 with a bifurcated demand structure. Suppliers are navigating long-cycle OEM program business alongside a fragmented aftermarket driven by vehicle age and failure rates. The industry is currently shifting toward more disciplined procurement and regionally diversified supply architectures.

stories.title: Hertz to close all physical car sales locations
stories.summary: Hertz will close its physical Hertz Car Sales stores to focus on an online retail strategy. The company stated the move is intended to meet customers where and how they want to shop. The transition follows a year of evolving its retail sales approach.

stories.title: Lithia Motors enters South Carolina market
stories.summary: Lithia Motors has acquired three dealerships in Charleston and North Charleston from Krause Auto Group. The transaction, which closed on 16 November, marks the national dealership operator's first expansion into South Carolina. Financial terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

stories.title: Cox Automotive on AI and dealer discoverability
stories.summary: Cox Automotive reports that AI is shifting vehicle search from a competition for position to a competition for inclusion. As AI begins to interpret and recommend vehicles for shoppers, dealerships risk being excluded from results if their inventory data is not easily understood by automated systems.

stories.title: Bidbus aims to upend vehicle auctions by letting dealers bid on consumers’ cars - Automotive News
Parks Automotive joins local chamber of commerce
stories.summary: Parks Automotive, a family-owned repair shop, has joined the Cape Girardeau Area Chamber of Commerce. The business, which is already a member of the Midwest Auto Care Alliance, says the move broadens its professional connections beyond the automotive industry. It was founded in 1983.

stories.title: FFUN Group enters U.S. market with Arizona acquisition
stories.summary: Saskatoon-based FFUN Group has acquired Planet Chrysler Dodge Jeep Ram in Flagstaff, marking its first U.S. dealership purchase. CEO Mark Loeppky said the move follows three to four years of searching for the right opportunity. He previously sold several Canadian dealerships to prepare for the expansion.

stories.title: Reading auto dealer charged after Jeep sale investigation
stories.summary: Osiris Baez Jr., owner of 61 Bros Auto Sales, faces charges following a state police investigation into a Jeep sale. A Schuylkill County woman reported purchasing the vehicle for $5,200 in cash via Facebook Marketplace. The investigation began in October after the woman reported problems with the purchase.

stories.title: FTC warns 97 dealers over deceptive pricing
stories.summary: The Federal Trade Commission has identified 97 dealerships warned for allegedly using deceptive pricing practices. The list includes major groups like AutoNation, Lithia Motors, and Hendrick Automotive Group. The agency says it wants to encourage dealers to ensure that advertised prices are transparent and truthful.

stories.title: Hero FinCorp targets loan disbursement growth
stories.summary: Hero FinCorp plans to double its loan disbursements over the next two quarters, citing a diverse portfolio and AI-led underwriting. The company, a division of Hero MotoCorp, reported disbursing 4.8 lakh loans in northern India between January and September. Growth is expected to be supported by its distribution network.

stories.title: Bank ordered to pay compensation after seizing truck
stories.summary: The National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered IndusInd Bank to pay Rs 7.7 lakh to a customer after the bank auctioned his truck over a Rs 43,000 default. The commission ruled in favour of the customer, who contested the bank’s actions through the national level.

stories.title: Rural India leads in festive loan applications
stories.summary: Rural markets accounted for 58 percent of consumer-durable loan applications between November 1 and 9, 2026, according to Lentra. Urban areas contributed 42 percent, with Tier-3 towns outpacing metropolitan cities. The average loan amount for festive purchases was approximately Rs 28,000.

stories.title: IndusInd Bank terminates former CEO
stories.summary: IndusInd Bank has terminated former MD and CEO Sumant Kathpalia following an internal inquiry into accounting discrepancies in its derivatives portfolio. The bank is invoking clawback provisions to recover compensation. Kathpalia had resigned in April 2025, citing moral responsibility for the lapses.

stories.title: IndusInd Bank fires former MD after internal probe
stories.summary: IndusInd Bank has fired former CEO Sumant Kathpalia and initiated clawback proceedings following an internal investigation. The action comes 18 months after Kathpalia resigned following the discovery of accounting irregularities in the bank’s derivatives portfolio. He had remained in the bank's employment during the disciplinary process.

stories.title: NBFC borrowing costs remain high
stories.summary: Borrowing costs for non-banking financial companies remain elevated despite a recent retreat in sovereign bond yields. Debt merchant bankers attribute the trend to tighter liquidity, rising credit spreads, and increased bank funding costs. The 10-year benchmark bond yield previously hit 7.48 percent in late October.

stories.title: Hero FinCorp disburses over 2.37 lakh loans across East India in 2026, aims to double growth over the next two quarters
RBI official links mis-selling to sales targets
stories.summary: RBI Deputy Governor SC Murmu stated that financial mis-selling is often driven by sales targets and variable pay structures rather than branch-level decisions. He urged institutions to review incentive mechanisms and prioritize customer outcomes. Mis-selling rarely begins at the branch counter, according to the deputy governor.

stories.title: Ken Garff Automotive schedules noteholder call
stories.summary: Ken Garff Automotive will host a conference call on December 3, 2026, to discuss its Q3 2026 financial results. The call is limited to current noteholders, prospective qualified institutional purchasers, and the trustee. Access instructions are provided through the company’s private data room.

stories.title: BlackBerry shifts focus to vehicle software
stories.summary: BlackBerry says its QNX software is now incorporated into more than 275 million vehicles worldwide. The company is pivoting toward software for industrial machines and communications systems, positioning itself as a provider of technology that sits beneath the applications consumers normally see.

stories.title: Quest Global receives automotive engineering recognition
stories.summary: Quest Global has been named a leader in automotive and mobility services by ISG. The recognition covers the company's capabilities in autonomous systems and software-defined vehicles across North America and Europe. The firm was also designated as a rising star in a third, unspecified category.

stories.title: New framework optimizes electric vehicle scheduling
stories.summary: A framework called FedRG-MARL enables decentralized electric vehicle scheduling across park microgrids. In simulations, the system achieved a 76.3 percent increase in mean daily profit compared to a graph-based baseline. The architecture allows autonomous controllers to balance charging demand while respecting local data privacy.

stories.title: AI framework automates vehicle design process
stories.summary: Researchers have developed an AI framework called CAMTF to recognize hand-drawn automotive sketches and retrieve matching 3D digital models. The system aims to address the bottleneck of translating artistic concept drawings into engineering-ready surfaces. The technology is designed to accelerate vehicle body development.

stories.title: Security teams told to rethink autonomous vehicle code
stories.summary: Autonomous driving software is now among the most complex code in commercial vehicles, and security teams are being told their old playbook does not fit. Engineers are advised that architecture diagrams fail to capture internal software trust boundaries. The code is now the attack surface.

stories.title: Self-Driving Vehicles Demand New Cybersecurity Thinking
stories.summary: Architecture-level analysis alone may not provide sufficient visibility into the full attack surface for autonomous driving systems. Key points Autonomous driving software complexity creates new cybersecurity risks beyond traditional vehicle threat modeling approaches. Architecture diagrams alone fail to capture critical implementation details and internal software trust boundaries. Security teams must

Lawmakers negotiate ban on Chinese vehicles
stories.summary: Lawmakers from auto-producing states are negotiating legislation to ban Chinese cars from the U.S. market. The bill aims to reach the President's desk before January. Meanwhile, Ford has started U.S. production of battery cells that use Chinese technology. The legislative process remains ongoing.

stories.title: Congress considers Chinese car ban with Mercedes exemption
stories.summary: US lawmakers are moving to push a ban on Chinese cars into law, with potential exemptions for automakers with passive Chinese ownership stakes. The rules would apply to companies like Mercedes-Benz, which has approximately 20 percent of its stock held by Chinese shareholders. The bill targets a January deadline.

stories.title: South Korea introduces tax credit for domestic EVs
stories.summary: South Korea is set to offer a corporate tax credit of $1,870 per electric vehicle manufactured and sold at home to counter Chinese imports. The measure is expected to provide domestic automakers with $217 million in annual savings. Local models currently face competition from Chinese-made vehicles.

Mahindra Racing reveals M13Electro livery for 2027
stories.summary: Mahindra Racing has unveiled the M13Electro, its car for the Formula E Gen4 era, featuring a red, black, and white color scheme. The team retains the colors used during the Gen3 period but has adopted a new layout. The reveal follows a third-place finish in Season 12.

stories.title: NASCAR drivers join Snowball Derby entry list
stories.summary: The 59th annual Snowball Derby at Five Flags Speedway will feature several drivers with experience in NASCAR's top three national touring series. The event, scheduled for December 3 to 6, combines short-track specialists with national-level competitors. The field is described as competitive.

stories.title: Stellantis Pulls Out Of Racing Except NASCAR Explained - TechnoSports Media Group
Mahindra Racing expands Valeo partnership for Gen4
stories.summary: Valeo has become the Official Performance and Engineering Partner for Mahindra Racing's Gen4 technical program. The collaboration will focus on developing software motor control algorithms and improving electric powertrain hardware. Valeo already supplies eAxle technology for the manufacturer's production vehicles.

Climate Cymru urges Welsh ministers to defend 2030 electric car target
stories.summary: A network of 430 organisations is urging the Welsh Government to defend the UK target for 80 percent of new cars to be zero-emission by 2030. Climate Cymru claims a target cut would leave households exposed to oil price swings. The target remains under review.

stories.title: UK's first electric-hybrid fire engine completes successful London trial
stories.summary: The Zero Emission Pumping Appliance has completed a year-long trial with the London Fire Brigade, attending 1,500 incidents on battery power alone. The brigade says the vehicle successfully performed in a demanding emergency response role. It is now fully integrated into frontline service.

stories.title: Chinese electric car brand JMEV shuts down showroom one year after opening
stories.summary: JMEV has closed its Singapore showroom after one year, making it the second brand to leave the market. Records show 28 cars were registered since 2025. Experts suggest that while basic parts may remain available, software fixes will now lack factory support.

stories.title: NIO marks 10 years with a 638,000 CNY gilded ES9 as the SUV's October sales slip 13% - GlobalChinaEV
New electric car sales in Ukraine drop 82 percent
stories.summary: Demand for electric vehicles in Ukraine has declined, with 430 new electric cars registered in October, an 82 percent drop from the same month in 2025. Used electric car registrations also fell by 44 percent. The market is currently moving in a different direction.

stories.title: Toyota introduces RAV4 plug-in hybrid to Middle East
stories.summary: Toyota has launched the RAV4 Plug-in Hybrid in the Middle East, calling it an important step toward carbon neutrality. The company says it continues to develop a range of electrified technologies to account for differing infrastructure and energy conditions across various global markets.

stories.title: Mercedes and Volkswagen stall German investment plans
stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has halted further investments at its German factories, citing high running costs. Production chief Michael Schiebe stated the company is forced to examine which sites to close if cost structures do not change. Volkswagen has also shelved plans to modernise its Wolfsburg plant.

stories.title: Tesla breaks 13-month sales losing streak in Europe
stories.summary: Tesla has recorded its first year-over-year increase in European registrations in 13 months, selling 13,740 cars across the EU, UK, and EFTA. While the broader European car market grew by 1.7 percent, EV sales rose by 15.8 percent. The losing streak is officially over.

stories.title: Japanese car brand expands its dealer network in South Africa - TopAuto.co.za
Dutch court bars Chinese SUV in Europe over design resemblance
stories.summary: A Dutch court has issued an injunction barring sales of the BYD Fangchengbao Ti7 in the EU, ruling it infringes on the design of the Jaguar Land Rover Defender. The ruling also blocks production of the SUV at BYD's upcoming plant in Hungary.

stories.title: Mitsubishi Mexico pivots as Chinese brands expand
stories.summary: Mitsubishi Motors Mexico is adjusting its strategy to address competition from Chinese automakers. The company is prioritising vehicle reliability and a seven-year warranty over price-based promotions to strengthen its market position. It is also preparing its distributor network for potential fiscal pressures in 2027.
